story: Algorithms to enhance or transform images
text: The "remove an object" image transformation reminds me of the Photoshop new feature "content-aware fill" featured here: [VIDEO]
Adobe calls it "Content Aware Fill" which is likely what you're thinking of. This was the video that blew everyone's mind, but its 7 years old at this point: [VIDEO]
